What I just said to the CV agent:

> You're right to say that language models, functional compute and ontology is how I convey it to someone who doesn't perhaps know what that is. What's the result of it? Well, it is something that can support the nature of what giving and receiving is. Good compute goes both ways. Good technology goes both ways. Good interfaces goes both ways. Good connections goes both ways. From the person using to the group, to the greater whole.

But to reply you, yes glass is it. Ontology is one of the primitives of another notion, the pure functional the other, and LLMs the third.

Oh I read your final paragraph now, yes very yes, spoken as channeled. Well said.

So, what is from here?
body.title: Both ways
